title: CSV/TSV writer configuration (fixture writerConfig.json shape)
description: EXP-4/EXP-5's host-side writer configuration — everything about the emitted file that the AG Grid wire request does NOT carry (EXP-1 exposes no delimiter, BOM or header-row field, which is why this is a separate file and not a member of agGridRequest.json). PRESENT ONLY WHEN A FIXTURE OVERRIDES A DEFAULT: a case proving a default (012's comma, 014's BOM-on, 025's tab-from-exportFormat) carries no writerConfig.json at all, so its expected bytes are produced by the writer's own defaults and would fail the moment one of them changed. Every property below is optional; an absent property means the writer's default.

delimiter.description: The field separator. Default ',' (EXP-4); ';' is EXP-4's first-class French/European preset; a tab comes from exportFormat: "tsv" rather than from here. Quoting follows THIS character, not a fixed one.

bom.description: EXP-4's optional UTF-8 BOM (EF BB BF), default true. False emits no mark.

headerRow.description: EXP-4's header row, default true. False emits data rows only.

decimalSeparator.description: EXP-5's decimal separator, default '.' (invariant culture). Equal to the delimiter, it is the collision EXP-5 requires the writer to reject — which no fixture can carry, since a rejected configuration produces no output file to compare against.
